name: ATL Productivity Suite
author: Accessible tech labs India
description: An enterprise-grade, accessibility-first global plugin engineered by Accessible Tech Labs India. Designed for visually impaired professionals, this Version 2.1 release transforms NVDA into the ultimate high-performance workstation assistant. Featuring 8 highly optimized utilities including a Pomodoro Focus Stopwatch, Advanced Sentinel Security Scanner, Voice-Assisted Alarms, Smart Workspace Launcher, and seamless Google Quick Search. You can press NVDA+Shift+M to instantly access the centralized ATL Master Menu. The ATL Suite delivers unparalleled speed, 100% privacy, security, and digital inclusion directly through your screen reader environment.
